summary: Iteration 3 tested the Denah viewport lock, per-pin colours with smaller dots and cones, the fixes from iteration_2, and regressions. Backend: 40 pytest cases passed and 1 was skipped (the last-admin guard). test_media.py gained new checks: malformed or reversed Range headers ('bytes=abc-', 'bytes=10-5', 'bytes=-abc', 'bytes=5-x') return 416 with 'bytes */size', and an empty music upload returns 400 'File kosong'. All of these pass. Frontend (Playwright with Clerk tickets, 390x844 and 1920x800): the Denah root becomes 'flex h-[100dvh] flex-col overflow-hidden'. scrollY stays 0 after mouse wheel, window.scrollTo(0,500) and a swipe-up drag, scrollHeight equals innerHeight, and the masthead (y=0) and plan stay visible. limitToBounds works: dragging at scale 1 leaves translate(0,0). Zoom in (scale 1.5) and reset (scale 1) work. Pin click opens Ruang at 04/06. The 'Daftar area' sheet opens, shows the coloured dots and opens a scene. Leaving Denah drops the lock (min-h-screen), and the Presentasi tab scrolls (scrollY 237). Pins: each has its own colour from the palette, and the cone fill matches the dot. Dot radius is 7.5px on mobile Denah, the Ruang > Denah sheet and the desktop mini-plan, and 9px on the wide desktop plan. The active pin is 1.2x bigger with a white ring. Numbers 01-06 are drawn on top and readable in all four places. Area-list colour dots match the pins. Music keeps playing across Ruang -> Denah -> Presentasi -> Ruang (currentTime kept rising). music-toggle-btn off pauses it, and autoplay on/off starts and stops it. The sample project still shows only the Ruang and Denah tabs. Next-scene, hotspots (2) and autoplay advancing all still work. ONE BUG: the PDF watermark fix does not work, and the watermark is still invisible on white PDF pages.

ui_bugs.issue: The watermark is still invisible on white PDF pages. The wrapper div is 'absolute z-[5]', and a positioned element with a z-index creates its own stacking context. That context isolates the child spans, so their mix-blend-difference only blends with the wrapper's transparent backdrop, not with the PDF image, and white/20% on white stays invisible. Confirmed: a screenshot of pdf-page-1 shows no watermark. After setting wrapper zIndex='auto' in devtools, the bottom-right label appeared, but the centre 'INERRE' was still very faint at 0.2 alpha.

design_issues.screen: Denah pins on a cream plan
issues: The pale palette colours (#f2cc8f pin 04, #a3c4f3, #c6b38b) at 0.5 fill opacity are hard to see on the cream/white plan, so cone 04 barely shows. Consider more saturated colours or a darker cone stroke.
The '/ 03' part (text-paper/45) is still dim, though '01' (text-paper/65) is fine.

action_items: Fix the Watermark: put mix-blend-difference on the wrapper div itself, or remove z-[5] / use 'isolation:auto' so the spans blend with the image. Raise the centre text alpha (around white/35-40) so it shows on white PDF pages. Re-verify on the Ruang renders too.
Optional: use more saturated pin colours for contrast on light plans.
critical_code_review_comments: Watermark.tsx: a z-indexed absolute wrapper isolates mix-blend children (see the UI bug above).
storage.get_object: recomputing sum(len(v)) over the whole cache on every insert is O(n). It is fine at 200 entries, but a running byte counter would be cleaner.
PlanView: number fontSize equals the dot radius (7.5px/9px), and the dot diameter is 15px, so 2-digit numbers just fit. 3-digit tour numbers (>99) would overflow, which is an edge case.
seed_data_creation: A TEST_UI Media T1 project (4735544b3b264a0b8a2843065394387f) was created via setup_ui_media.py and deleted at the end. The sample project was not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use python /app/backend/tests/ticket.py client to get a sign-in ticket (one per browser session). Use setup_ui_media.py to create a media project and 'setup_ui_media.py delete <pid>' to remove it. Only the watermark visibility on the PDF needs a recheck.
